industries.name: Construction
industries.heading: Construction Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply skilled and semi-skilled construction workforce for infrastructure, residential, and commercial projects across the Gulf, Europe, and Asia — screened for trade certification, hands-on skill, and site safety readiness.

industries.name: Manufacturing
industries.roles: Machine Operators, Quality Inspectors, Assembly Workers
industries.heading: Manufacturing Workforce Supply
industries.body: From CNC-qualified technicians to assembly line operators, we supply manufacturing workforce matched against machine-specific experience and quality-control training for factories across Europe and Asia.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.heading: Healthcare Workforce Supply
industries.body: We source caregivers, nurses, and healthcare support staff for hospitals, care homes, and home-care employers, with credential verification and, where required, language and licensing readiness support.

industries.name: Hospitality
industries.roles: Hotel Staff, Chefs, Housekeeping, Restaurant Staff
industries.heading: Hospitality Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply hotel, restaurant, and housekeeping staff for hospitality employers across the Gulf and Asia, screened for guest-service experience and, where relevant, culinary or food-safety certification.

industries.name: IT & Engineering
industries.roles: Software Developers, IT Support, Mechanical/Electrical Engineers
industries.heading: IT & Engineering Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply degree-qualified software developers, IT support engineers, and mechanical/electrical engineers, sourced against formal qualifications and verified through technical assessment for employers in Germany, Japan, and the Gulf.

industries.name: Agriculture
industries.heading: Agriculture Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply farm and food-processing workforce for agricultural employers, screened for hands-on field experience and physical fitness for seasonal and year-round roles.

industries.name: Facilities Management
industries.roles: MEP Technicians, Security Guards, Cleaners, Drivers
industries.heading: Facilities Management Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply MEP technicians, security staff, drivers, and cleaning teams for facilities management contracts across the Gulf, verified for trade certification and, where needed, driving or security licensing.

industries.name: Logistics & Warehousing
industries.heading: Logistics & Warehousing Workforce Supply
industries.body: We supply warehouse and logistics workforce — including forklift-certified operators — for distribution and fulfillment employers across Europe's manufacturing and logistics hubs.
